verdict.rationale: PagerDuty documents an official MCP server that lets AI assistants securely manage incidents, using the same API token and OAuth authentication as the REST API. The REST API can access and manipulate account data, with an interactive OpenAPI reference, and Events API v2 follow-up events explicitly acknowledge or resolve alerts, so an agent can run the core lifecycle without the dashboard. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that escalation can be triggered via API/MCP (escalation evidence describes only automatic policy behavior), a listing of the specific incident tools the MCP server exposes, and independent or hands-on corroboration of an agent completing the full loop.
